violation_type.title: Critical Injury - Ensure Supervision of All Children (26 TAC §746.3607(5))
violation_type.short_title: Critical Injury - Ensure Supervision of All Children
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was found that the caregiver did not practice proper supervision of all the children in her care after leaving the room with the injured child, resulting in a child being left unattended.

finding_variants.text: During the investigation, it was found that the caregiver did not practice proper supervision of all the children in her care after leaving the room with the injured child, resulting in a child being left unattended.
A caregiver did not have visual awareness of the children in care at the time of the incident.
